quotes.author: Jada Smith
quotes.text: Ohana Kai is the best water sport rental I’ve ever used!!! I feel like I’ve been scammed everywhere else I’ve been - my brother and I had a perfect sunset jet ski experience thanks to these guys, will definitely be using again!

quotes.author: stacey yamamoto
quotes.text: Such friendly staff and super helpful with getting our group set up with all the correct waivers and rules and regs. Ready for a fun time out on lake washington!

quotes.author: Scott Schroeder
quotes.text: We had a lot of fun. The jet skis were in good condition and ran well. Also, this Southern part of Lake Washington seemed less crowded.
